scope_reconciliation.original_scope: Propositional/ proofs with manual simp only [listImp_*, bigconj_*] lists
scope_reconciliation.finding: Zero listImp_*/bigconj_* simp-only sites exist under Cslib/Logics/Propositional/. bigconj is never referenced in Propositional/ at all. All 20 sites live in Foundations/, Modal/, Temporal/, Bimodal/, plus one file in Propositional/Metalogic/.
scope_reconciliation.recommended_scope: Repo-wide removal of redundant listImp/bigconj normalization rewrites: 8 files, 20 tactic sites, 62 net lines removed. Superset of the original scope (includes Propositional/Metalogic/GenericMCSBridge.lean).

key_findings: All 20 simp only [listImp_*|bigconj_*] invocations in the repository are redundant: listImp_nil/_cons and bigconj_nil/_singleton/_cons_cons are all proved by rfl, ListDeriv is a transparent def, and DerivationSystem.Deriv is a plain structure field -- so exact discharges every site by defeq.
15 accompanying 'unfold ListDeriv' and 'simp only [<algDS alias>, treeAlgDS, algebraicDerivationSystem]' unfolds are equally redundant.

The four per-logic GenericMCSBridge derivTreeToList proofs are copy-pasted variants of one anti-pattern; Bimodal shrinks 32 tactic lines -> 13, Temporal 26 -> 12, Modal 24 -> 11, Propositional 12 -> 7.

The change set was applied and verified empirically, not merely proposed: full lake build (3309 jobs) green with all 8 files edited simultaneously; lake lint clean on all changed files; grep for residual target sites returns 0.
GenericMCS.lean:242 unfoldListImp is a noncomputable def returning DATA, so its simpa->exact change alters the produced term; this is why full-project (not per-module) verification is mandatory.
No new definitions, lemmas, axioms, attributes, or notation are recommended. The task-268 'co-tags' premise is moot: the normalization lemmas already carry @[simp, scoped grind =].
